title: Disease Prediction from Multi-Angle Imaging
tagline: Eight angles in, a more confident read out.

meta.title: Disease Prediction from Multi-Angle Imaging | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Eight angles in, a more confident read out.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Diagnosing certain hair and skin conditions from manual examination alone is subjective and often needs multiple consultations to confirm.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: A CNN-based model processes the multi-angle image set and detects visual indicators of disease across all eight views together.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: More consistent diagnostic support, including for remote consultations without a specialist on-site.
